subject: [PATCH v4 3/8] mm/page_alloc: snapshot the preferred zone against shrink rebuilds

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag without any specific comments or suggestions.

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug in the page allocation code where the preferred zone is not properly handled during shrink rebuilds, leading to a kernel NULL pointer dereference. The fix involves reading the preferred zone only once and using a stale value if it becomes NULL.
